title: Lumentum buys optical components maker NeoPhotonics for $918M

sources.quote: today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement under which Lumentum will acquire NeoPhotonics for $16.00 per share in cash, which represents a total equity value of approximately $918 million.

explain: Lumentum paid NeoPhotonics shareholders $16 a share in cash, about $918 million, for its lasers and optical parts used in high-speed data center and telecom links. The deal closed in August 2022.
